notes.title: Official Version First Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35909460/5f9855c4a6b577403b726ff90e1a471fa4f712cd.png[/img]
Hello, zombie slayers!

In the days following the release of the official version, we have received an abundance of enthusiastic feedback from players. We want to express our gratitude for your support, and we are honored to see that you are enjoying our game!

To enhance the exhilarating experience of blasting zombies, we have just launched the first update since the official version went live. Here are the details of this update:

[list]
[*] Increased Melee Weapon charge damage coefficient. 
[*] Fixed Rifle Arsenal unobtainable after finishing the boss kill quests.
     (For those who have already finishing the boss kill quests, please kill any of the listed boss for the item to be dropped) 
[*] Fixed Dark Knight's shadow has damage collision before dashing.
[*] Fixed pausing the game will prevent certain cinematics from progressing. 
[*] Enhanced boss battles: 
 Adjusted Gravekeeper skill cooldown. 
 Adjusted Hansel and Gretel fight arena to prevent boss glitching out of the boss arena.
[*] Other bug fixes.
[/list]
The gates of the town will always be open to all of you. We encourage you to provide more feedback, as we will continue to work hard to make the game even better. Please stay tuned for more updates!

Best regards from dev team, 
August 17th

notes.title: Zombie Soup Full Release Now Available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35909460/5f9855c4a6b577403b726ff90e1a471fa4f712cd.png[/img]

Hello, brave heroes!

We have some exciting news to share with you all today! "Zombie Soup" has officially been released! And it's available on multiple platforms like PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch. We want to express our gratitude for your support during the EA period!

To all the new players who have purchased the official version, welcome to the town where you can have a blast fighting off enemies and using the wide variety of weapons in "Zombie Soup" to save your sweet dates. But beware of the powerful bosses, their ferocity is no 

We will be releasing optimization updates in the coming days and continuously polishing the game with more updates. Additionally, we are thrilled to announce that we will soon be launching a artbook and original soundtracks. So, please stay tuned!

We would love to hear your feedback and suggestions. Our goal is to provide you with the best gaming experience possible!

Best regards from the development team!
August 13th

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.7
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35909460/5f9855c4a6b577403b726ff90e1a471fa4f712cd.png[/img]

Welcome, brave heroes!

During the two-month Early Access, we're sure you've already killed countless zombies with all manner of weapons. On behalf of the townspeople, we would like to thank you for your efforts!

In this update, we've optimized and added the following features to make your zombie-shooting experience even more exhilarating. Get ready to enter the town while your guns are still hot!

- Significantly improved loading speed
- New feature: You can now skip the main menu animation by pressing ESC (keyboard) or B (controller back button)
- Each boss now has a unique entrance sound effect
- Improved Dark Knight's model
- Optimized the placement layout of crates
- Improved enemy perception and behavior
- Rooftop will now properly save the cinematic progress
- Back alley fix on the fall down animation during cinematic sequence
- Other bug fixes

We will continue to polish and update the game. Stay tuned!

The development team
August 7, 2023

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35909460/5f9855c4a6b577403b726ff90e1a471fa4f712cd.png[/img]
Greetings,

Thank you for your support and feedback for "Zombie Soup." Below are the details of the first patch update:

- Fixed some language issues where voice acting and dialogues did not match
- Fixed some crashes caused by loading errors
- Optimized the hitbox of certain bosses
- Optimized the skill release order of some bosses
- Improved background music
- Adjusted the names of some collectibles
- Corrected the names of some weapons

Once again, thank you all. We will continue to work on updates and strive to do better!

Development Team 
June 12, 2023

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Updated Demo
notes.notes:
Hey guys! The Zombie Soup team has been running around lately attending several conventions and we're very sorry for not fixing a particular bug issue earlier in one of the tutorial screens in the demo where some players may not be able to proceed further. 

We have also taken the opportunity to make adjustments to the boss fights based on feedback from players who played the demo in the abovementioned conventions with a new update.

With that, the entire team expresses their sincerest apologies to those who were unable to enjoy the demo as much as we had hoped, but we wish for you to continue helping us improve the game further as we draw closer to launch.
